paragraphs.text: Darka was an ainok Atarka -clan tracker and experienced hunter in the past of Tarkir .

Darka was a quiet ainok , characterized by his fur and tough skin suitable for the harsh environment. He could be recognized by his wet fur smell and quiet demeanor. Darka was disciplined and skilled, a dependable member of the tribe trusted by Yasova . He, along with his comrades Oiyan , Mattak , Rakhan , Sorya , and Fec , demonstrated loyalty and competence throughout their journey. He was proud, evident in his unyielding demeanor even in the face of death. This pride and discipline highlighted his loyalty and commitment to his tribe.

During a dangerous journey to Ugin 's tomb, Darka was assigned to sentry duty. As a dragon tempest approached, he and others sought shelter in a rock chamber. However, Atarka intercepted the group. When Atarka demanded to know how her broodling died, she grabbed Darka, declaring him a tasty snack, and swiftly killed him by biting off his head. His death was accepted with stoic resignation, and his remains were later honored by the tribe in their traditional manner, highlighting his bravery and the tribe's respect for their fallen.
